title: Nullhomotopy of a diagonally factored cone transition
statement: Let T be a category and A an abelian category, C and D integer cochain complexes in Fun(T,A), alpha:C→D a chain map, and t:m→n a morphism of T. Suppose b:D(m)→C(n) is a chain map such that alpha(m) followed by b is C(t), and b followed by alpha(n) is D(t), in every degree. Form the mapping cone Z of alpha in Fun(T,A), then evaluate. The transition Z(t):Z(m)→Z(n) is nullhomotopic.

source.place: Tags 014E (definition-cone) and 014F (lemma-functorial-cone); explicit off-diagonal homotopy calculation.

proof.text: Use h_i=snd_i at m, followed by b_i and the source inclusion into the cone at n in degree i-1; all other homotopy components are zero. Expand d h+h d with the cone differential. The chain-map identity for b cancels the two mixed terms. The factorization identities replace the two remaining terms by the source and target transitions. The cone decomposition of the identity and naturality identify their sum with the cone transition. These calculations are valid for unbounded complexes and also for zero objects.

mathlib_searches.query: A square of cochain complexes factoring through its diagonal gives a nullhomotopic map of mapping cones
mathlib_searches.results: Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap, nullHomotopy, mappingCone.descHomotopy and liftHomotopy construct homotopies, but no diagonal-factorization theorem was found.

mathlib_searches.query: A commutative square of chain maps with a diagonal factorization in both triangles induces a nullhomotopic map on mapping cones
mathlib_searches.results: mappingCone.mapOfHomotopy, descHomotopy and liftHomotopy are generic APIs; no match for evaluated strict cone transitions or ramified scalar pullback.

Generic mapping-cone and homotopy-equivalence results only. Local searches of both library roots found consumers of pro-zero cones, not the required diagonal for these finite pullback reductions. Blueprint searches for cone transition homotopy and scalar pullback factorization found no matching imported node.

theorem diagonalConeTransitionHomotopy
    {T : Type*} [Category T] {A : Type*} [Category A] [Abelian A]
    {C D : CochainComplex (T ⥤ A) ℤ} (α : C ⟶ D)
    {m n : T} (t : m ⟶ n)
    (b : D.asFunctor.obj m ⟶ C.asFunctor.obj n)
    (h₁ : ∀ i : ℤ, (α.f i).app m ≫ b.f i = (C.X i).map t)
    (h₂ : ∀ i : ℤ, b.f i ≫ (α.f i).app n = (D.X i).map t) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy ((mappingCone α).asFunctor.map t) 0)
